overall_summary: Analysis of deduplicated observations weighted by recent performance reveals that high-concept space and astrophysics scenarios—specifically extreme exoplanets and mind-bending cosmic properties ('What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?', 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year', 'The Planet Darker Than Coal')—are significantly outperforming psychological facts, standard animal trivia, and general science. Videos framed around immersive physical hypotheticals ('What If You Fell Into...') and rare astronomical anomalies generate the highest velocity of views-per-day, likes-per-view, and meaningful comment engagement. In contrast, standard psychological tricks and recycled animal facts show stagnant or minimal traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,030 views, 36 likes) achieve the highest view counts and engagement ratios compared to standard science facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on space exploration and extreme planetary survival scenarios, framing them as high-stakes physics hypotheticals rather than passive textbook facts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles challenging conventional time or scale logic, such as 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) and 'Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet', capture strong early traction.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form concepts focused on bizarre universal paradoxes that break human intuition about time, space, and physics.

weak_patterns.evidence: Content focused on mild psychological phenomena or brain hacks (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs') yields negligible view velocity (5–53 views).
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological tricks and standard cognitive trivia unless paired with a high-intensity, unexplainable mystery.

weak_patterns.evidence: Simple declarative animal facts ('Octopuses Have THREE Hearts', 'The Only Animal That Can Live Forever') underperform compared to cinematic or extreme survival framing.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content away from static listicle facts toward high-stakes cinematic animal survival or extreme environmental adaptations.
